description: Address 3 issues from v2 review: residual innerHTML XSS in loadCloudPhotos error handler, thumbnailUrl returns non-renderable Drive page URL, and unbounded ScriptProperties growth in generateTransactionId and validatePayment.
steps: In index.html, replace innerHTML XSS in loadCloudPhotos withFailureHandler with safe DOM APIs (createElement, textContent).
In BackendService.gs getPhotoHistory, change thumbnailUrl from f.getUrl() to Drive thumbnail API URL format.
In BackendService.gs generateTransactionId, remove the ScriptProperties write since replay protection is handled by the active-subscription check in activateSubscription.
In BackendService.gs validatePayment, remove the ScriptProperties write since the active-subscription check in activateSubscription already prevents replay.
acceptance_criteria: loadCloudPhotos failure handler uses textContent instead of innerHTML with unsanitized err.message
generateTransactionId does not write to ScriptProperties
validatePayment does not write to or read from ScriptProperties
